notes: The dash-enclosed line «- قال ابن رافع حدثنا وقال الآخران، أخبرنا عبد الرزاق، -» is an editor's note on the verbs, but it names Abd al-Razzaq as the teacher of Ma'mar, so he is kept as a link.

needs_ruling: Malik's first-person account («أرسل إلى عمر») is not settled as a transmission. Umar speaks in the scene and is not a link. «بنحو حديث مالك» and «وربما قال معمر» are wording variants and are left out.
